description.value: Country Grocer is a family-owned Vancouver Island supermarket chain with over 40 years of history, emphasizing locally sourced BC products and strong community ties. The Ladysmith location sits in the heart of town across from Aggie Fields, offering a full supermarket selection plus deli, sushi, bakery, and seafood platters prepared fresh to order. It is part of an eleven-store independent Island chain that prioritizes relationships with local farmers and producers.
